exact_duplicate_policy: One representative per normalized dialogue/label; training-source order then source row
conflicting_label_policy: Retain distinct labels for identical dialogue; keep together in one split group
near_duplicate_policy: Retain reviewed near-identical records; group together
filter_order: exact dialogue/label deduplication, then rare-class filtering, then splitting
limitation: Similarity screening and inspected pairs do not prove absence of all related encounters
